## Design

### 2026-10-02 — So in the beginning I brainstormed Ideas. Initially I was planning on making a line following robot, but unfortunately I only had 1 ir sensor, and I couldnt really figure out how to work with one only

**10h**

So in the beginning I brainstormed Ideas. Initially I was planning on making a line following robot, but unfortunately I only had 1 ir sensor, and I couldnt really figure out how to work with one only, I only knew how to use 2. So then I decided I'd create a robot controlled by my phone.

I started assembling the chassis, and that was pretty easy for me, I attached motors, tyres, the cell holder, the front wheel, and put the cells in. I enjoyed assembling the car chassis alot.

![72286](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gPy9vGSnDjpFBviU1SGmA0OJaRLqTIjX/74b3c6bc97d806d691d82c430c211c9335c4e22d42512529709ee21984028d1b.jpg)

I used 3000mah cells. I put them in the cell holder.

![72300](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gPy9vGSnDjpFBviU1SGmA0OJaRLqTIjX/3180084109fa5c45591331e57b39a61b9076d216e00bc2898ef6cf9b1b1d6621.jpg)

Now, this project started to get trickier. I had to power the l298N with the cells. I could do that easily, but then I realized that I had to first connect the cells to the switch in between. I don't really have a soldering iron, so that would've been tricky (and yes it was tricky) I used electrical tape and somehow made it work. Then I connected the ls98N with the other "arm" of the switch.

![72296](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gPy9vGSnDjpFBviU1SGmA0OJaRLqTIjX/0738f7a586ea47e8e4d0af7535f8bcc27cd9396b94d0dd7c64f5f5c9f64bdda5.jpg)

Then I connected the motors to the l298N. And when I turn on the switch. The l298N lights up.

![72297](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gPy9vGSnDjpFBviU1SGmA0OJaRLqTIjX/45a38516c505e45c4eabcbe1dbe3eda16805b64797572bc8ce55e95720e78146.jpg)

The next step was connecting the arduino uno r3. Now I messed up alot at this point. But after quite alot of tries. It kind of worked. But currently the cells were powering both the l298N and the Arduino.

![72298](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gPy9vGSnDjpFBviU1SGmA0OJaRLqTIjX/2fbff11f9c1396b2b2fbd12ef53d6664d29ae1e62379e67af857ec50f7a630ee.jpg)

So then I turned the switch off, and now I was trying to find a place to stick the Arduino uno, so that It could stay in place while I upload the code from my computer. And I kind of found one.

![72299](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gPy9vGSnDjpFBviU1SGmA0OJaRLqTIjX/4b39cd9146f431ce72a57731b31f2d97e20c716685624217692b19286cc00447.jpg)

Now was the tricky part. The coding. I'm not that good at coding hardware. And this was my first time. So first I learnt the code and then I implemented it. At this point, when I pressed F on my keyboard. The car was going forward. One tyre at least. And when I pressed B it was going backwards, both tyres. This is the code I used.

![72305](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gPy9vGSnDjpFBviU1SGmA0OJaRLqTIjX/0de4c3027c9dd7ea285724d9def996770044b7b197f17c5fecc507c116303604.jpg)

Then I had to diagnose why one of my tyres weren't going forward so I used another code that would make my tyres go forward for 2 seconds, and backwards for two seconds. And that's exactly how I found out that one of the output channels of my l298N had gone bad. Anyways I changed the wiring, so now both tyres go forward but only one tyre goes backward.

![72306](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gPy9vGSnDjpFBviU1SGmA0OJaRLqTIjX/7ee36f3b1524a2cead1fc41b0746bfe429327ca919966574da732c0e3422c74c.jpg)

This is me uploading the code.

![72307](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gPy9vGSnDjpFBviU1SGmA0OJaRLqTIjX/9ff3cc277c0693d8e019d94005c321102dbc546e1cb977d505af452ddf597d0b.jpg)

Then I tried connecting the Bluetooth module. But my Bluetooth module was not working. And this is when I realized, I can no longer make a phone controlled robot. But instead of losing hope, I just changed my project. Now my robot does whatever code I feed it. So it goes 2 seconds forward, and 2 seconds backward. But since only 1 tyre goes backward, my robot just changes direction. And I'm powering my Arduino through a 9 volt battery.and l298N with the cells. Here's the final look:

![72311](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gPy9vGSnDjpFBviU1SGmA0OJaRLqTIjX/ff64de698d748389bda6895a71534f92210af0d277eec57c5f0046930832b617.jpg)

OVERALL I'm REALLY happy with my project even though I had a limited amount of resources, I'm glad I made my first ever robot!
